shelters.name: Central Dakota Humane Society
shelters.description: Serving Bismarck-Mandan and central North Dakota for more than 60 years. Rescues, houses, rehabilitates, and rehomes stray, injured, abandoned, and abused animals.

shelters.name: Homeward Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Rescues, shelters, protects, and rehomes animals. Mission to care for, protect, and place animals in lifelong homes while preventing cruelty through education.

shelters.name: James River Humane Society
shelters.description: Established 1985, nonprofit no-kill shelter set up to care for homeless cats and dogs. Located at I-94 Exit 262, Bloom Exit.

shelters.name: Journey Home Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Mission is to be a part of an animal's journey to a better life. Animal rescue serving the Grand Forks area.

shelters.name: Furry Friends Rockin' Rescue
shelters.description: Nonprofit started 2014, incorporated 2015 by Bismarck Animal Impound volunteers. Volunteer-run to alleviate pound overcrowding and euthanization.

shelters.name: 4 Luv of Dog Rescue
shelters.description: 100% volunteer-run rescue. Provides and pays for all necessities for foster animals - fosters only provide loving home until dog gets adopted.

shelters.name: Circle of Friends Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving the Grand Forks area of northeast North Dakota.

shelters.name: Souris Valley Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving Minot and the Souris Valley region of north-central North Dakota.

shelters.name: Cat's Cradle Shelter
shelters.description: Cat shelter serving the Fargo-Moorhead area of eastern North Dakota.

shelters.name: TLC-ND Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Devils Lake and the surrounding region.

shelters.name: Oreo's Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Dickinson and southwest North Dakota.

shelters.name: MonDak Animal Rescue
shelters.description: Animal rescue serving Williston and the Montana-Dakota border region.

shelters.name: Miles of Love Dog Rescue
shelters.description: Dog rescue organization founded 2017 serving the Bismarck-Mandan area.

shelters.name: North Dakota Animals in Need
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization founded 2014 serving central North Dakota.

shelters.name: Spay and Neuter Center
shelters.description: Animal welfare organization founded 2011 providing spay/neuter services in the Bismarck area.

notes: Comprehensive collection of North Dakota animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Central Dakota Humane Society has served 60+ years. James River Humane Society is a no-kill shelter since 1985. Coverage spans Fargo, Bismarck-Mandan, Jamestown, Grand Forks, Minot, Devils Lake, Dickinson, and Williston.
